subject: Queue the Prithvi-600M b28 full runs from an in-cluster CronJob
description: Tobias decided on 2026-11-16 to replace the app-bound watcher for the Prithvi-600M b28 runs (task 0167; Claude scheduled task imint-prithvi-b28-chain, which only runs while the desktop app is open) with an in-cluster CronJob on ICE [user-stated 2026-11-16]. Every 15 min it checks im023-prithvi600m-smoke: once it has succeeded it server-dry-runs and creates im023-prithvi600m-b28 and im023-prithvi600m-control from the copies pinned at 21086305d34a (Tobias's go 2026-11-14 to queue both without asking again [user-stated 2026-11-14]); on a failed or missing smoke, existing full runs, or after 2026-11-28T20:00Z it creates nothing and suspends itself. Narrow SA/Role (jobs get/list/create, its own cronjob get/patch, no delete). Not in scope: the repo's k8s/im023/prithvi600m yamls (PR #159 may re-pin them), the smoke job itself. Review: Codex via headless dispatch.
